samples.question: What is ticket OS-4 about?
samples.answer: Ticket OS-4 is about SCIM provisioning from Azure AD creating duplicate employee records when the identity provider retries timed-out create requests. The retries are treated as new employees instead of updating the existing ones, resulting in duplicate records with the same work email.
